examName: NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors
steps: Confirm your Electrician license is active and in good standing in California.
Submit a license verification request from California through the appropriate national registry or the state board directly.
File an application for universal license recognition (endorsement) with Ohio's licensing board.
Register for and pass the required exam: NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors.
Pay the Ohio application fee (approx. $210) and submit supporting documents.
Await processing — typically 14-45 days in Ohio.
notes: Ohio's electrician licensing requirements are administered per the state's licensing authority. Ohio trade licenses for larger jurisdictions go through the Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board (OCILB); some smaller municipalities license independently. Always confirm current rules directly with the official board before applying, since requirements change.
